about: The site inventory (#1298, #1866). siteInventory.ts FINDS every site that could be re-modelling Strudel; each row here CLASSIFIES one, in the open. Classes: authoring (builds Strudel/mini text from a model), hand-grammar (decides Strudel/mini syntax meaning by hand), js-grammar (decides JavaScript structure by hand), surgery (re-spells one leaf at a named span, or copies the user's bytes), boundary (locates whitespace/delimiters, decides nothing), other-text (not Strudel or JS source). authoring, hand-grammar and js-grammar are ratcheted in ledger.json. First classified 2026-10-01 by reading each site; the reasons are one line each.
